Visitors can wander amidst shops overflowing with metallic gleams, each step bringing a profound sense of appreciation for the intricate craftsmanship on display. Witnessing firsthand the exquisite goldsmithing works instills a deep admiration, helping visitors fully understand the enduring vitality and cultural significance of this traditional craft street in the heart of a bustling city.
